model_x_eq_D.binding_caveat: No D* > 8 is licensed as a draw budget by this analysis. The law is the Pearson reliability law for independent additive noise, fitted to Spearman correlations of seven exhaustively overlapping summaries of the same eight time-ordered draws; a high R^2 can be algebraic smoothing rather than out-of-range validation, and subsets spanning the full 8-draw horizon are not equivalent to a fresh D-draw run at fixed thinning. D* is a model-based heuristic, explicitly unidentified beyond the observed range. A real budget requires new independent chains/draws.
